incidents.name: Xave Finance SafeNap DAO module unrestricted execution
incidents.lossOther: 100,000,000,000,000 RNBW minted and RNBW ownership transferred to the attacker
incidents.notes: The SafeNap DAO module let any address submit and then execute arbitrary Gnosis Safe transactions without a governance check, which the attacker used to mint 100 trillion RNBW and take ownership of the token.

sources.ref: onchain review: module 0x8f9036732b9aa9b82D8F35e54B71faeb2f573E2F created 2021-06-24T18:41:14Z by 0x30ca8f1e13978a7a819af012665cfa7e49f1c554, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. Loss is denominated in minted RNBW; the token price collapsed and no reliable realised-USD figure exists, but the sold portion was well above the $1,000 floor.
